name: 点と線・人物の印で担当者別の作業を示すグラフのひな型
prompt:
Refine the previous candidate using the primary original source crop as the geometry authority. Keep its 300:206 aspect ratio, rounded card, title 「担当者ごとの今週の作業」, four photo avatars, bright-blue lollipop marks and current horizontal x positions unchanged.

Correct only vertical placement of the chart group. In the 600x412 enlarged source crop, the four blue point centers are near (63,197), (145,250), (226,225), and (307,288). Their thin lines reach one shared avatar row centered near y=349. The faint horizontal guide is near y=236. The previous candidate placed every chart element about 28px too high. Move all four dots, their connecting vertical lines, the guide and all four portraits downward about 28px in these 2x crop coordinates, preserving their relative positions, sizes and order.

Keep the title in place. Preserve exactly four blue points and exactly four small photo portraits in the same order. Do not change the existing horizontal spacing, point-height order, line lengths beyond the common downward shift, portrait size, portrait appearance, blue color, or card margins. Do not add names, labels, values, or more marks.
reviewNotes: Candidate v002 compared side-by-side with the original 2x crop. Dimensions 1514x1039 (1.4572:1) against source 300x206 (1.4563:1); SHA-256 fe0f1d6bd055a64b1bc4a6b3e533748ae302a67e527d6f18e6a5672c22d851b3. The chart group moved closer and preserves all four x positions, point-height order, blue marks and four distinct photo portraits. Residual: dots, guide, lines and portrait baseline remain about 4–5% too high, leaving excess bottom whitespace. Two attempts used, status needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
